summary:
Project Name: Space Data Explorer

Challenge: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer (NASA Space Apps Challenge)

Core Objective: An interactive, web-based training platform designed to educate and test junior astronauts using real NASA open data and gamified simulation scenarios.

Tech Stack & Architecture: Built as a lightning-fast, single-file vanilla application (index.html) optimized for instant deployment via GitHub Pages.

NASA Data Integration:

NASA APOD API: Streams live daily space imagery and scientific explanations.

NASA DONKI API: Fetches real-time space weather alerts (solar flares and coronal mass ejections) to teach radiation safety.

Mars Trek & Lunar Data: Integrates surface environmental telemetry (gravity, temperature, and atmospheric composition).

Key Features & Gamification:

Interactive Explorer Tabs: Seamless switching between cosmos observations, planetary telemetry, and live space weather.

Junior Astronaut Training Simulator: Pre-flight quiz scenarios addressing emergency protocols and space habitat survival.

XP & Wing Badge Certification: Progressive rank system allowing cadets to unlock official Junior Astronaut status upon reaching 300 Mission XP.

Offline Fallback Architecture: Built-in resilient datasets ensuring 100% uptime and error-free evaluation even under network latency or API rate limits.
details:
• Project Title: Space Data Explorer
  • Challenge Name: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
  • Project Summary / Description: Space Data Explorer is an interactive, web-based training platform designed to educate and test junior astronauts using real-time NASA open science data. The application features live astronomical feeds from the NASA APOD API, space weather and solar flare monitoring via the NASA DONKI API, and planetary telemetry for Mars and the Moon. It incorporates gamified pre-flight training scenarios, mission XP progression, and offline fallback architectures to provide a resilient, engaging educational experience for young space explorers.
  • Tech Stack / Tools Used: React, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, NASA Open APIs (APOD & DONKI), Netlify / GitHub Pages for hosting.
